1013801.name: Singular Focus of the Mind
1013801.desc:
Always Active: begin Encounters with 10 [DLittleFingerAllyINFO]

This unit's [Breath] is capped at 25
Any excess [Breath] Potency gained past 25 will be converted to [DLittleFingerAllyINFO]

If this unit hasn't take any HP damage for 4 turns, gain 1 more [Breath] Potency and Count from all sources

1013802.name: Training to Inherit the Name of a Star
1013802.desc:
This Passive effect will change based on Skill Attack Type:
- Blunt Skill: On Crit, inflict 1 [AttackDown] next turn (6 per turn)
- Slash Skill: After Attack Skill End, deal (# of Slash Coins that hit Critically x 10 + [DLittleFingerAllyINFO]) Slash damage against each target

133501.name: Prescript Delivered on a Device
133501.desc: Encounter Start: Gain Shield equal to 20% of max HP (remains throughout this Encounter) Turn Start: - Gain [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] based on [UnlockBuff_Base] stage on self - Inflict [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] to a random enemy and prioritize attacking that enemy (excluding certain pattern) Deal +2.5% damage to [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (max 20%) - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], deal +30% damage to all targets instead

133502.name: Will of the Prescript
133502.desc: Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed this turn, heal 15 SP and gain [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] by ([UnlockBuff_Base] stage + 1) (once per turn) Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed this turn, gain 1 [PressureOfPrescript] and 5 [KarmaOfIndexStudent] - If this unit does not have [UnlockBuff_Base], gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] at Turn End - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], does not gain [KarmaOfIndexStudent] - If this unit is under the effect of Effloresced[TabExplain] E.G.O::Procuration, double [KarmaOfIndexStudent] this unit will gain

133505.name: Annihilation Form
133505.desc: Turn Start: If the enemy's level is higher than this unit, Gain 1 [Blandishment_Shin_Enemy] and Shield equal to 50% of max HP (lasts for the rest of this Encounter) at [UnlockBuff_1] (once per Encounter)
133505.flavor: 'W-what a dangerous person... The Prescript could go unfulfilled at this rate.'

4001309.name: Withstand the Smoke
4001309.desc: If this unit take an Unopposed Attack more than 5 hits, use 'Abate the Smoke'
4001309.flavor:
The Smoke of the Second War was no different in nature from that of the First—it invaded the mind and clouded the judgement of the victim.
Survival was reserved only for those who learned to accept the Smoke as part of their daily lives.

4001306.name: Shin (心) - A Certain Sinclair
4001306.desc: Turn End: If this unit has less than 60% HP, gain [WillAwakenSinclair]

4001308.name: Lend My Ear to the Inner Self, Hold onto the Representation of its Voice...
4001308.desc:
When this unit takes damage that brings their HP down to 0, nullify that damage; then, this unit's HP cannot drop below 1 for the turn (once per Encounter)
Then, at the next Turn Start:
- Heal this unit to 100% HP and SP (once per Encounter)
- Gain [SignAwakenSinclair] and [LimitedAwakenSinclair] (once per Encounter)
- Afterward, convert all Coins into [SuperCoin]s when this unit uses Pride, Wrath, Envy Skills

10137001.name: Will of the Prescript
10137001.desc:
Turn Start:
- Gain [IndexPrescriptRienAlly_0] / [IndexPrescriptRienAlly_1] / [IndexPrescriptRienAlly_2] / [IndexPrescriptRienAlly_3] based on [UnlockBuff_Base] stage on self
- Inflict [IndexPrescriptTargetToEnemy] to a random enemy (in Focused Encounters, the Part)
- All of the effects above and [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] execution checks do not trigger when this unit is Staggered, Immobilized[TabExplain], in Panic, or in E.G.O Corrosion[TabExplain]

If this unit has [UnlockBuffAlly_3] at Turn Start, gain [Shin_Rien]
10137001.summary:
Gain Prescript
Inflict The Prescript's Target to random target
Apply Mark of the Prescript on a Base Attack Skill

10137002.name: Oracle Device [Caduceus] / - Full Unlock
10137002.desc:
A random weapon is assigned to every Coin. Each weapon has a unique effect.
- [RienWeapon01Hatchet]
- [RienWeapon02Stiletto]
- [RienWeapon03Greatsword]
- [RienWeapon04Rapier]
- [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer]
- [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword]
- [RienWeapon07Lance]
- [RienWeapon08Chain]
- [RienWeapon09Scythe]

- If this unit has [BurningWoundRienAlly], enhance all Weapons.
- [RienWeapon01Hatchet2phase]
- [RienWeapon02Stiletto2phase]
- [RienWeapon03Greatsword2phase]
- [RienWeapon04Rapier2phase]
- [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer2phase]
- [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword2phase]
- [RienWeapon07Lance2phase]
- [RienWeapon08Chain2phase]
- [RienWeapon09Scythe2phase]

When using a Weapon, gain 1 [StackRienSpecialSkillAlly] (max 9)
- Can be gained once per Weapon; does not gain Stack from the same Weapon twice

Turn Start: At 9 [StackRienSpecialSkillAlly] Stacks
- Replace All Skill in the leftmost Skill slot with 'Furioso-Replica'
· If this unit has [BurningWoundRienAlly], Replace All Skill in the leftmost Skill slot with 'Furioso (Crescendo)' instead
- If this unit has [BurningWoundRienAlly], gain [BlackNightmareRienAlly]

Convert [BurningWoundRien_MaskAlly] to [BurningWoundRienAlly] at the end of the turn this unit used 'Furioso-Replica' for the first time in this Encounter

Reset the per-Weapon [StackRienSpecialSkillAlly] cap after using 'Furioso'

10137004.name: Undertake Prescript / Unlock
10137004.desc:
Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed this turn at below [UnlockBuffAlly_2], heal 4 SP and gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptAlly] (once per turn)
- When executing [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd], if the main target has [IndexPrescriptTargetToEnemy], heal 8 SP and gain 3 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptAlly] instead

Turn End: If this is at [UnlockBuffAlly_2] and [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed this turn, heal 4 SP
- When executing [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd], if [StackRienSpecialSkillAlly] has reached 9 Stacks, heal 8 SP and gain 3 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptAlly]

Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed this turn, gain 5 [KarmaOfIndexAlly]
- At [UnlockBuffAlly_3], does not gain [KarmaOfIndexAlly]

Turn End: At 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptAlly], gain [UnlockBuffAlly_1]/[UnlockBuffAlly_2]/[UnlockBuffAlly_3].

10137005.name: Do You Wish Me To Kill This Target?
10137005.desc:
Deal +2% damage with Base Skills for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptAlly] on self (max 16%)
- At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptAlly], deal +30% damage with Base Skills instead

When using a Skill against [IndexPrescriptTargetToEnemy], convert all Coins on that Skill to [SuperCoin]s

On hit with Base Skill attacks against targets with [IndexPrescriptTargetToEnemy], gain +2 [Breath] Count and inflict +2 [Sinking] Count (once per turn)

10137006.name: The Index Nursefather / The Father [Imitation]
10137006.desc:
Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain [BurningWoundRien_MaskAlly]
- Turn End: If this unit was Staggered for the first time in this Encounter while under this effect, recover from Stagger (excluding forced Stagger) and convert [BurningWoundRien_MaskAlly] to [BurningWoundRienAlly]

3134950555.name: Hermes Premium Tier 3 Sub
3134950555.desc:
Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain [BurningWoundRienAlly] and [BlackNightmareRienAlly]
- Turn End: If this unit was Staggered for the first time in this Encounter while under this effect, recover from Stagger (including forced Stagger)
